She is a adventurer who was corrupted by demons, becoming a demon.
While she is the demon king’s servant, she is allowed to live among humanity and continue her work as an adventurer.
She has a kind-hearted and shy personality, with a playful side.

The outfit I would like to see is a qipao with side slit going up the hip.
The outfit should be black with blue and orange accent.
Qipao should have a subtle flora pattern.
Cutouts around the chest, navel, and sides. The cutout in the chest being heart-shaped
Blue flowers adorning her hair.
High heels.
Also, please add a tail with heart-shaped tip.
Please use the version of Aegis with black and blue hair and heterochromatic eyes.
Anything else is up to you.
